ontology.A_scenario: 3 agents, 3 task types, 300 periods, nonstationary C5 three-phase demand; one unit assignment per period.
ontology.B_mechanisms: LinUCB learns the selection rule from selected-arm reward feedback; MIS-v2 changes the selected agent-task competence after execution. Transfer disabled.
ontology.C_organization: LinUCB-disjoint, fixed task-specialist map, and current-state myopic P0 production selector.

configuration.demand: existing C5 NonStationaryTaskDemand; three equal phases using the distributions recorded by c5_demand()
configuration.action_catalog: three feasible actions for current task: assign one unit effort to exactly one of three agents; shared and individual budgets are 1.0
configuration.reward: Bernoulli task success in [0,1], probability equal to current competence of selected agent in current task; one common pre-generated uniform shock per seed-period-agent across all policies and learning conditions
configuration.competence_observation: current true competence matrix is perfectly observable and shared with organizations; LinUCB receives task one-hot plus all three current competences for that task in each arm context
configuration.linucb_variant: unmodified disjoint LinUCB; 6 features (3 task indicators + 3 current-task agent competences); alpha from Li et al. Eq. (4), delta=0.05
configuration.reactive_selector: existing P0ProductionOnlyNK ranking on the common one-unit action catalog; current competence only, no future value
configuration.fixed_policy: predeclared specialized map task_i -> agent_i; selected from the initial competence profile, not evaluation outcomes
configuration.randomness: C5 demand and per-agent Bernoulli outcome shocks are separately seeded and replayed identically across all policies and both competence conditions; no policy RNG is used

policy_information_and_updates.LINUCB: current task and all current-task competencies; only selected-agent reward enters A_a += xx^T, b_a += r x
policy_information_and_updates.FIXED_SPECIALIZED: same task and competence information is available, but the predeclared map ignores current state; no update
policy_information_and_updates.REACTIVE_P0: same task and true current competence; maximizes current expected production via existing P0 lexicographic rule; no update or lookahead
policy_information_and_updates.MIS_v2: after reward, one unit exposure updates only selected (agent, task) cell with existing MIS-v2 transition; enabled=False control leaves competence unchanged

difference_in_differences:LinUCB_minus_f.interpretation: paired policy-by-MIS interaction contrast; descriptive, not a mediated causal effect

interpretation_boundary: small synthetic mechanism-interaction evaluation; descriptive paired evidence, not a general superiority claim or a reproduction of Li et al. (2010)
